subject: Exec intro + brief — sponsor anchor and demo handback
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Cho <amelia.cho@quantasys.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@quantasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-17T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Exec intro + brief: Redwood demo (VP/CIO presence)

Hi Amelia / Raj —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call yesterday. As discussed, we'd love to host a targeted executive brief + product demo next week so your VP/CIO can see the end-to-end experience and ask any architecture or procurement questions. To avoid overloading calendars, our suggested format is:

- 20–25 min: executive sponsor conversation (outcomes, success criteria, billing/SLA expectations)
- 30 min: product demo + live Q&A with engineering

Proposed windows (all times ET):
- Tue 11/18: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 11/19: 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00

Can you confirm which window works best and whether the VP and CIO will be able to join the sponsor portion? If helpful we can also split into two short sessions (exec + technical) on different days.

I attached a short executive deck and a one-page agenda.

Next steps: confirm preferred time, names/emails for calendar invite (procurement contact is useful to include), and any pre-demo items you want covered (security/compliance, latency targets, region).

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Sergio —

Appreciate the clear format. VP Hsu can join for the sponsor portion; CIO Chen is tentatively available but I need to confirm a hard yes. Our procurement lead, Lena Morris (lena.morris@quantasys.com), should be on the invite for contract-level questions.

Our preference is Wed 11/19 15:00–16:00 ET. If that works, please send a calendar hold and include Lena. Also send any short pre-demo checklist (SOC2, data retention, KMS info) so I can flag to the security team.

Thanks — looking forward.
Amelia

- We can do Wed 11/19 15:00–16:00 ET.
- We'll plan for a 25-min sponsor segment (Sergio + Marissa) and a 30-min technical demo with an engineer present for live Q&A.
- I'll attach a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lists key milestones (security review, procurement timing, pilot start).
- Pre-demo checklist (SOC2, retention policy, KMS/HSM integration notes) attached as a one-pager — happy to add anything your security team needs ahead of time.

Next steps for us: I will send a calendar invite once Lena confirms availability. Please let me know if you prefer a single combined session or two back-to-back items (exec + tech).

Best,
